name: print-social-halftone-folder-banner-tiktok-shop
title: Rainbow halftone banner with a 'tiktok shop' folder and blue scribble
whatItIs: A wide banner with a red, green and blue halftone gradient, a manila folder labelled 'tiktok shop', a big blue scribble burst, a cursor, and tool icons for Photoshop, Illustrator and Figma.
whatItMeans: Loud, playful and unified; halftone brings the series together even as colours change.
techniques: Switch the gradient colours per category while keeping the folder identical.
Use a loose blue scribble behind the folder for energy.
Overlay halftone dots on saturated colour fields.
Keep icons around the folder as skill indicators.

vocabulary.definition: Changing background colours while keeping structure.
A rough hand-drawn star behind an object.
The pattern of dots in halftone.
One of a set sharing structure.
